reviews.comment:
Excelente todo siempre y todo el año. Destaco la amabilidad de la empleada que trabaja en los baños. Es súper atenta y mantiene todo impecable. Cuándo venís viajando con niñxs es fundamental tener instalaciones disponibles,limpias y de calidad. Muchas gracias!!. Parar a tomar algo y comer, es un relax rutero necesario.

(Translated by Google)
Everything is excellent, always, all year round. I especially want to highlight the kindness of the employee who works in the restrooms. She's incredibly attentive and keeps everything spotless. When you're traveling with children, having clean, high-quality facilities available is essential. Thank you so much! Stopping for a drink and a bite to eat is a much-needed break on the road.
